subject.title: [Feature]: Publish WhatsApp Status updates from the message tool

question: Should the official WhatsApp plugin support agent-published Status updates, and must every explicit audience member be present in the account's outbound allowFrom policy?
rationale: Source and Baileys contracts establish feasibility, but repository behavior does not answer whether an owner-gated agent may broadcast to contacts outside the existing outbound allowlist; that privacy and product contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor allowlisted Status
options.body: Add the opt-in action but require every audience member to pass the existing account outbound allowlist, preserving one authorization source of truth.

options.title: Sponsor owner-wide Status
options.body: Allow a trusted owner turn to target explicit contacts outside allowFrom, accepting a broader and separately documented authorization boundary.

options.title: Defer Status publishing
options.body: Keep the feature unsupported until demand and live Baileys stability justify the additional privacy-sensitive surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor allowlisted Status
recommendation.body: Add the opt-in action but require every audience member to pass the existing account outbound allowlist, preserving one authorization source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the broadest ownership of WhatsApp plugin boundaries and channel-specific config placement, which are the central product decisions here.
